rationale: The update introduces security-relevant behavioral changes, including one new sensitive API usage, fourteen dynamic-execution indicators, six source-to-sink heuristic indicators, substantial obfuscation-related signals, and broad structural modifications across the extension. Network destinations also changed substantially, although the overall destination-count delta decreased, so the new external-network count should not be interpreted as a simple expansion in network access. No new permissions or host-scope expansion were introduced, and there is no independent public evidence confirming malicious intent or data exfiltration. Therefore, the transition is assessed as RISKY_TRANSITION rather than MALICIOUS_TRANSITION.
